title: lophophora diffusa subsp. viridescens
intro: Lophophora diffusa subsp. viridescens, commonly known as 'Viridescens' or 'green peyote', is a subspecies of cactus native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is a psychoactive plant that contains the alkaloid mescaline, which is responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Lophophora diffusa subsp. viridescens include its potential to reduce anxiety, improve mood, and enhance spiritual experiences. The plant's bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which may also exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
